map.延长呼气与屏息可激活副交感神经、降低心率与皮质醇，由 Andrew Weil 推: Lengthening the exhale and the hold can activate the parasympathetic nervous system and lower heart rate and cortisol; it was popularised by Andrew Weil. It is a relaxation technique rather than a treatment, and anyone with severe insomnia must see a doctor to find the cause.
map.模式：4-7-8 呼吸法（吸气 4 秒 → 屏息 7 秒 → 呼气 8 秒），目:
Mode: the 4-7-8 breathing method (inhale 4 s, hold 7 s, exhale 8 s) with a target of 5 cycles.
One cycle = 4 + 7 + 8 = 19 s; five cycles take 5 x 19 = 9...
map.焦虑发作或公开演讲前用箱式(4-4-4-4)呼吸稳定心率与注意力。: Use box breathing (4-4-4-4) before an anxiety attack or a public talk to steady the heart rate and attention.
